objects.name: Chipkin Example B-ASC
objects.note: vendor 389 (Chipkin Automation Systems); instance configurable with --deviceID and the Object_Name with --deviceName (both at start-up; the heading shows the defaults). The stack rows are device-wide facts only the stack knows - the protocol version and revision it implements, the services and object types it was configured with, the live object list and address-binding table, and Database_Revision, which the stack starts at 0 and increments for each object added at start-up: it reads 8 (the Device and its seven objects) and stays 8, because nothing creates, deletes or renames an object afterwards (a command or a DeviceCommunicationControl changes no object). The accepted rows are the stack's configured defaults for APDU limits, segmentation and system status; an application that answered them from its own constants could contradict the stack, so this example does not

objects.name: Bronze
objects.note: REAL, degrees Celsius; read-only; the temperature the simulated heating valve produces - it moves up to 1.0 C a second toward the winning Analog Output 1 setpoint (starts at 21.5)

objects.name: Emerald
objects.note: read-only; the simulated relay's feedback contact - takes the winning Binary Output 1 command within a second (starts inactive)

objects.name: Hot Pink
objects.note: 3 states: On, Off, Auto; read-only; the simulated drive's speed - takes the winning Multi-State Output 1 command within a second

objects.name: Chartreuse
objects.note: REAL setpoint, default 20.0 C, accepts 10.0 .. 30.0 (Min_Pres_Value / Max_Pres_Value, else value-out-of-range); Reliability no-fault-detected, or no-output while the simulated valve actuator is disconnected (the stack derives Status_Flags FAULT from it); commandable via a 16-slot Priority_Array (WriteProperty, DS-WP-B) - Present_Value/Priority_Array/Current_Command_Priority are resolved by the stack from the slots the app serves through GetPropertyReal/GetPropertyBool

objects.name: Fuchsia
objects.note: active/inactive, default inactive; commandable via a 16-slot Priority_Array (WriteProperty, DS-WP-B) - Present_Value/Priority_Array/Current_Command_Priority are resolved by the stack from the slots the app serves through GetPropertyEnumerated/GetPropertyBool

objects.name: Indigo
objects.note: state 1 of 3, default state 1; commandable via a 16-slot Priority_Array (WriteProperty, DS-WP-B) - Present_Value/Priority_Array/Current_Command_Priority are resolved by the stack from the slots the app serves through GetPropertyUnsignedInteger/GetPropertyBool

objects.name: Vermilion
objects.note: BACnet/IP; Network_Type and Protocol_Level are set from BACnetStack_AddNetworkPortObject()'s arguments (IPv4, BACnet Application) at start-up, not a GetProperty callback like the object's other app-served rows; Changes_Pending is likewise computed and answered natively by the stack's Network Port object. Reliability has no fault condition this example detects, so it is accepted at the generic default (normal)
